biotools.summary: EndoMAP.v1 is a resource providing a systematic human endosomal structural interactome, combining crosslinking and native gel mass spectrometry with AlphaFold predictions to chart the structural landscape of human early endosome complexes. It offers structural models and a network viewer for understanding organellar structural interactomes.
